package postgres

import (
	"context"

	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain/repository"
	"github.com/jackc/pgx/v5"
	"github.com/jackc/pgx/v5/pgconn"
	"github.com/jackc/pgx/v5/pgxpool"
)

type txKey struct{}

// DBRunner exposes pgx query methods for pool/tx.
type DBRunner interface {
	Exec(ctx context.Context, sql string, arguments ...any) (pgconn.CommandTag, error)
	Query(ctx context.Context, sql string, args ...any) (pgx.Rows, error)
	QueryRow(ctx context.Context, sql string, args ...any) pgx.Row
}

type txBeginner interface {
	Begin(ctx context.Context) (pgx.Tx, error)
}

func getRunner(ctx context.Context, pool *pgxpool.Pool) DBRunner {
	if runner, ok := ctx.Value(txKey{}).(DBRunner); ok && runner != nil {
		return runner
	}
	return pool
}

// TxManagerPG wraps transactional execution for pgx.
type TxManagerPG struct {
	Pool txBeginner
}

// WithTx executes fn in a transaction.
func (m TxManagerPG) WithTx(ctx repository.Context, fn func(ctx repository.Context) error) error {
	if _, ok := ctx.Value(txKey{}).(DBRunner); ok {
		return fn(ctx)
	}
	tx, err := m.Pool.Begin(ctx)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	defer func() { _ = tx.Rollback(ctx) }()
	ctx = context.WithValue(ctx, txKey{}, tx)
	ctx, scope := repository.WithTransactionScope(ctx)
	if err := fn(ctx); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if err := tx.Commit(ctx); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	scope.RunAfterCommit()
	return nil
}

var _ repository.TransactionManager = (*TxManagerPG)(nil)
